questions.question: Explain two ways the Nazis reduced unemployment. (4 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: Rearmament: conscription from March 1935 removed young men from the workforce, and arms factories employed millions. The RAD (National Labour Service): made compulsory in June 1935, it placed young men in work camps doing manual labour, removing them from unemployment figures.

questions.question: How important was rearmament in reducing German unemployment? (8 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: Rearmament was the most important factor in reducing unemployment. Government spending on arms rose from 3.5 billion marks (1933) to 30 billion marks (1939). Conscription removed hundreds of thousands of young men from the workforce. Arms factories employed millions directly and in supply industries. By 1939, 40% of government spending was military. questions.question: Explain the purpose and impact of the Strength Through Joy programme. (8 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: The Strength Through Joy (KdF) programme provided subsidised leisure activities for workers: cruises (180,000 participants in 1938), package holidays, theatre tickets (43 million sold by 1939), and sports. questions.correctAnswer: The Nazis did NOT create an economic miracle.
